confidence_notes: Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors rest on 2026 cost-of-living aggregators and Chiang Mai nightlife guides, but sources disagree and some are undated, so treat them as bounded estimates. Cocktail prices come from a 2026 Chiang Mai guide. Wine by the glass has no direct Chiang Mai data; its anchor is derived from the local beer relationship and Thai house-wine ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates without any accommodation search or live listing check. Thai baht to USD conversions use an assumed rate of about 33 THB per USD. The FX observation was taken from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened, so the 16 October figure should be checked against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable foreign city was used. Anchors are based on Thai local price points for Chiang Mai (Nimman, Old City and Loi Kroh price bands and cost-of-living aggregator figures), with the July low-season context applied to accommodation.
